paragraphs: Safety Vision designs and delivers mobile video surveillance and fleet safety systems for organizations that run vehicles. The company says it designs, builds, installs and maintains solutions for virtually any mobile video surveillance application. Hardware spans recorders, interior and exterior cameras, monitors, sensors, battery backups and portable camera kits, alongside software for managing and viewing video.

The site groups the work by industry, listing student transportation, mass transit, public safety and commercial trucking. School districts get a platform meant to increase student safety both on and off the bus, and transit fleets get equipment protecting drivers, passengers and assets. For public safety, the pages say fire, EMS and law enforcement fleets use the mobile surveillance products, and commercial vehicle customers use them to protect trucks, drivers and assets.

Software includes SafetyNET 5, a video management system the company developed, and SafeDrive AI 2, a windshield camera and recorder combining driver assistance with driver behavior monitoring. A plugin for Milestone XProtect lets on-prem and mobile video surveillance be monitored in one place. The homepage states adherence to National Defense Authorization Act requirements in procurement and membership in the AWS Partner Network.
